instructions.question: Does this marker comment line carry a tracking reference?
instructions.note: `item` is one source line with a TODO, FIXME, XXX or HACK comment. Judge only the text of the line.

criteria.true: The line holds an issue or pull request number (#123, gh-123, issue 123, PR 123), a URL starting with http:// or https://, or a name or version in parentheses right after the marker (TODO(name), FIXME(1.11)), or an @name after it (TODO @name).
criteria.false: The line holds none of these: it is a plain note, even if it describes a concrete task or names a file, function or person elsewhere in the sentence.
